test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.text: Success comes from making one major change in life.
Small daily improvements, when repeated consistently, lead to significant long-term results
Negative habits have no real impact unless they are extreme.
Success is mostly determined by luck rather than effort.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

• Success is portrayed as the result of consistent daily choices rather than a single dramatic change.
 
• The passage emphasizes the idea of "compound interest" applied to habits—small improvements accumulate over time.
